1.0.1: Updated component name and file picker.
1.0.2: Updated component inputs and removed file picker.
1.1.0: ListFiles: The recursive flag has been added. When set to true, the component will list all files, including those within sub-folders.
1.1.1: NewFile: fix for tracking changes on a custom drive.
1.1.2: Fix for possible connection with empty label.
1.1.3: NewFile: triggers only for new files in the watched Drive, not folders.
1.2.0: (new component) UpdatedFile - triggers when a file is updated in selected Drive or Drive folders (works recursively).
(new component) DeletedFile - triggers when a file is deleted in selected Drive or Drive folders (works recursively).
(new component) Find Files or Folders - Searches for files or folders in selected Drive using Query (works recursively).
DownloadFile - added option to output file data.
1.2.1: DownloadFile - allows to select format in which to download the file. Possible options: pdf, html, txt.
1.2.2: FindFilesOrFolders - updated Item Type to File Type.
1.2.3: Connection can now be created with custom tenant. To see the option while creating the connection, in the Admin -> Connector Configuration add configuration 'appmixer:microsoft' and inside it, add item 'microsoftTenant' and set its value to true.
1.3.0: Implemented multiselect input normalization for fileTypesRestriction field in ListFiles, FindFilesOrFolders, NewFile, and UpdatedFile components.
1.3.1: The authentication flow now displays an account selection screen.
1.3.2: Reduced icon size for better performance.
1.3.3: Added output examples to component schemas.
2.0.0: (breaking change) MakeApiCall: headers and parameters changed to key-value array inputs (body remains textarea/JSON to support nested structures) per standard #1459 — existing flows that used the old string/textarea headers or parameters must be updated
2.1.0: Added test() (Flow Test Mode) to the WatchLocation trigger.
2.2.0: Added test() (Flow Test Mode) to the NewFile and UpdatedFile triggers.
2.3.0: NewFile, UpdatedFile, DeletedFile, WatchLocation: the delta backlog is now processed page by page with the resume link persisted after every page, so a redelivered notification or a late failure no longer replays the whole backlog.

NewFile, UpdatedFile, DeletedFile, WatchLocation: the component lock is taken with an explicit TTL and extended before every Graph call, and at most 20 delta pages are processed per run - the rest continues on the next tick.

NewFile, UpdatedFile, DeletedFile: the webhook renewal in tick() no longer retries a contended lock 30 times, which used to throw 'LockError: Exceeded 30 attempts to lock the resource' every minute while a notification was being processed.
WatchLocation: changes are emitted before the delta link is stored, so a crash replays a page instead of dropping it.
NewFile, UpdatedFile: a file matching several File Types Restriction prefixes at once is now emitted once instead of once per matching prefix.
All Microsoft Graph calls made through the legacy request helper now have a 30 s timeout so a hung call cannot hold a component lock indefinitely.

NewFile, UpdatedFile: the 'created since' cutoff now advances to when the delta chain was started rather than when it was finished, so a file created while a backlog was being processed is no longer skipped. NewFile remembers the files it emitted recently so such a file does not fire twice; UpdatedFile also reports a file created after the cutoff once it has been modified.

NewFile, UpdatedFile, DeletedFile, WatchLocation: an expired delta link (410 resyncRequired) is replaced by a fresh baseline, with the gap logged, instead of failing on every notification. A transient failure part-way through a backlog is retried on the next tick, and the subscription renewal in tick() runs even when that retry fails.

Output examples for every output field of CreateFolder, DeletedFile, DownloadFile, GetFile, ListDrives, ListSites, MoveFileOrFolder, NewFile, UpdatedFile, UploadFile and WatchLocation; WatchLocation's output schema declared its nested fields as label/value pairs and its leaves without types.
CreateFolder, GetFile, ListDrives: a missing required input is reported as a clear error instead of a failed Graph call.
3.0.0: BREAKING: MakeApiCall now declares every OAuth scope the SharePoint components use (added Files.Read.All, Sites.Read.All and Subscription.Read.All), per the MakeApiCall standard #1459 - SharePoint has no single most privileged scope. It can now call every endpoint the other SharePoint components can, including /subscriptions. Accounts connected before this version have to be reconnected before a flow with MakeApiCall starts.

MakeApiCall: a path starting with '/' - the documented form - was sent to https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/https://graph.microsoft.com/..., and every request with a body failed with a TypeError inside onedrive-api; it now calls Microsoft Graph directly. A full URL is accepted only on https://graph.microsoft.com, so the account's token is never sent to another host.

ListFiles, FindFilesOrFolders: the Items array output declared field names the data never contained (createdByUserId, parentReferencePath and the other flattened names) and typed Size as a string. Both components now publish the driveItem shape Microsoft Graph really returns, including the previously missing File, Folder, File System Info and Shared fields, with Size as a number. Every field path the previous output offered still resolves.

ListFiles, FindFilesOrFolders: a missing Drive ID is reported as a clear error instead of a failed Graph call, and the output field list is now fetched without the connected account, so the variable picker fills in even before a Drive is selected.
3.0.1: MakeApiCall: Request Headers and Query Parameters set in the Designer are now sent. They were silently dropped: the key-value field stores its rows as a JSON object string, which the component did not parse.
